Date: 2022-12-21 What Is Claimed Is:
1. A method for the at least partially automated guidance of a motor vehicle (401) within an infrastructure, comprising the following steps:
receipt (101) of first instruction signals by a first server of a first operator of the infrastructure, the instruction signals representing an instruction (405) of an instruction giver for the at least partially automated guidance of the motor vehicle (401) within the infrastructure, a first check (103) by the first server of whether the instruction (405) is able to be executed, transmission (105) of second instruction signals by the first server to a second server of a platform for the at least partially automated guidance of a motor vehicle (401) within the infrastructure of a second operator in the event of a positive first check, the second instruction signals representing the instruction (405) for the at least partially automated guidance of the motor vehicle (401) within the infrastructure, a second check (107) by the second server of whether the instruction (405) is able to be executed, generation (109) of control signals for the at least partially automated control of a lateral and/or longitudinal guidance of the motor vehicle (401) on the basis of the instruction (405) by the platform in the event of a positive second check, in such a way that the instruction (405) is executed in an at least partially automated control of the lateral and/or longitudinal guidance of the motor vehicle (401), and
output (111) of the generated control signals.
2. The method as recited in Claim 1, wherein first certificate signals, which represent a first digital certificate (407), are received by the first server, the first check being carried out on the basis of the first digital certificate (407), the first digital certificate (407) comprising a first data set, which comprises one or more of the following data items:
specification data of the motor vehicle (401), which represent a technical specification regarding an at least partially automated guidance of the motor vehicle (401);
identification data, which represent an identification of the motor vehicle (401), and/or of a driver (403) of the motor vehicle (401), and/or of the instruction giver.
3. The method as recited in Claim 2, wherein in the event of a positive check, the first digital certificate (407) is transmitted by the first server to the second server, so that the second server receives the first digital certificate (407), the second check being carried out on the basis of the first digital certificate (407).
4. The method as recited in Claim 3, wherein second certificate signals, which represent a second digital certificate (415), are received by the second server, the second check being carried out on the basis of the second digital certificate (415), the second digital certificate (415) comprising a second data set, which comprises one or more of the following data items:
specification data of the motor vehicle (401), which represent a technical specification regarding an at least partially automated guidance of the motor vehicle (401);
identification data, which represent an identification of
the motor vehicle (401), and/or of a driver (403) of the motor vehicle (401), and/or of the instruction giver.
5. The method as recited in one of the preceding claims, wherein the first check comprises a check of whether the instruction giver has made payments required for the at least partially automated guidance of the motor vehicle (401), and/or it is ensured that payments required for the at least partially automated guidance of the motor vehicle are being made, e.g., by direct debit or by consent(s).
6. The method as recited in one of the preceding claims, wherein the second check comprises a check of whether the first operator has made payments required for the at least partially automated guidance of the motor vehicle (401), and/or it is ensured that payments required for the at least partially automated guidance of the motor vehicle are being made, e.g., by direct debit or by consent(s).
7. The method as recited in one of the preceding claims, wherein the second check comprises a check of whether the instruction (405) transmitted by the first server is signed by a digital signature of the first operator.
8. The method as recited in one of the preceding claims, wherein the infrastructure is an element selected from the following group of infrastructure elements: parking facility, in particular parking garage, tunnel, bridge, construction site, junction, in particular four-way or three-way junction, entrance ramp of a freeway, toll station.
9. A system (201) for the at least partially automated guidance of a motor vehicle (401) within an infrastructure, wherein the system (201) is designed to execute all the steps of the method according to one of the preceding claims, the system (201) comprising the first server and the platform.
10. A computer program (303), comprising commands which, when the computer program (303) is executed by a computer, cause the computer to execute a method according to one of Claims 1 through 8.
11. A machine-readable storage medium (301), on which the computer program (303) according to Claim 10 is stored. 24Literal Translation 25Literal Translation 26Literal Translation 27Literal Translation
